provenance_correction: Discovered that best_effort_timestamp_time provides reliable timing data when pkt_pts_time is empty. Added command: ffprobe -show_entries frame=best_effort_timestamp_time -select_streams v:0 -of json <input_file.mp4>
research_summary: Research confirmed blank pts_time in WebM/MediaRecorder files is due to missing Cues indices. Recommendation: Use '-fflags +genpts' for auditing packets. For container repair, use 'ffmpeg -i input.webm -c copy -cues_to_front 1 output.mkv' to inject Cues and stabilize timestamp indexing.
